claims.text: Rasagiline: 1 mg once daily as monotherapy;
with levodopa start 0.5 mg once daily, increasing to 1 mg if needed.
claims.quote: As adjunct to levodopa: AZILECT 0.5 mg once daily. Increase dose to 1 mg daily as needed for sufficient clinical response

claims.text: With ciprofloxacin or other CYP1A2 inhibitors, don't exceed 0.5 mg once daily.
claims.quote: Patients taking concomitant ciprofloxacin or other CYP1A2 inhibitors should not exceed a dose of AZILECT 0.5 mg once daily

claims.text: Selegiline: 10 mg/day as 5 mg at breakfast and 5 mg at lunch.
claims.quote: The recommended regimen for the administration of selegiline hydrochloride is 10 mg per day administered as divided doses of 5 mg each taken at breakfast and lunch.

claims.text: Advise patients not to exceed selegiline 10 mg/day and explain the 'cheese reaction';
claims.quote: should be advised not to exceed the daily recommended dose of 10 mg. The risk of using higher daily doses of selegiline should be explained, and a brief description of the `cheese reaction' provided.

claims.text: rare hypertensive reactions with tyramine-containing foods have occurred even at the recommended dose, and selectivity for MAO-B falls as the dose rises.
claims.quote: Rare cases of hypertensive reactions associated with ingestion of tyramine-containing foods have been reported in patients taking the recommended daily dose of selegiline. The selectivity is further diminished with increasing daily doses.
